name: Mephibosheth
summary: The son of Jonathan and grandson of Saul, lame in both feet since he was a child. King David showed him kindness for Jonathan's sake and gave him a place at the king's table.

key_moments.title: Made Lame in a Fall
key_moments.description: When news of Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, five-year-old Mephibosheth's nurse picked him up and ran. In her haste he fell and became lame.

key_moments.title: Given a Seat at David's Table
key_moments.description: David asked if anyone was left of Saul's house to show kindness to for Jonathan's sake. He gave Mephibosheth all of Saul's land and had him eat at the king's table like one of his own sons.

key_moments.title: Welcomes David Home
key_moments.description: All the time David was away, Mephibosheth did not care for his feet, his beard or his clothes. He told the king his servant had deceived him, and said Ziba could take everything, since the king had come home in peace.
